scope: Bounded geography/role/confirmation fixes before frontend integration; no universal NLU/geocoder claim.

source_review.interpretation: Filtered geographic issue/utterance index, not an actual80 replay or a numerical NLU score.

findings.fact: A first city+country assertion without from/origin or an active destination slot lost the city role; the country alone produced another generic city question.
findings.fix: Known leading city plus explicit country is grounded as one destination assertion; a country mismatch keeps unrelated operations and asks confirmation.
findings.controlled_proof: Four city/country pure contradictions and initial-conflict six-turn PG dialogue.
findings.actual_closure: Repeat the same first utterance through a real remote model; origin/people/budget saved, incompatible city/country never committed as such.

findings.fact: Yes/no followed by an independent edit did not bind to the active destination proposal; a declined proposal could remain pending.
findings.fix: Bound yes/no prefix only to a fresh destination proposal and an explicit independent non-geographic edit. Questions, country/city mentions, history, vetoes and hypotheticals cannot grant consent.
findings.controlled_proof: Compound yes/no pure cases plus twelve-turn PG child7->8/budget/pause conversation.
findings.actual_closure: Actual multi-turn yes/no plus edits preserve current adult/budget and apply only current confirmed country/city.

findings.fact: The first country-conflict question had a generated future stay alias, but accepting it with another edit could not resolve a target because no stay existed yet.
findings.fix: Only when no stays exist, admit the bounded server-style stay-N/new-stay-N alias already bound in the pending question.
findings.controlled_proof: Saved initial FAIL then pure continuation and six-turn PG first-proposal acceptance.
findings.actual_closure: Actual new-chat conflict->compound acceptance creates exactly one owned stay; no phantom second stay.

findings.fact: Late yes after declining a city unnecessarily fell through to the model instead of asking for a city in the retained country.
findings.fix: A destination question without a proposed city answers bare yes/no with its existing human question and no operation/model request.
findings.controlled_proof: Two declined-proposal/late-yes phases in the twelve-turn PG dialogue; exact adapter-call counts.
findings.actual_closure: Actual refusal then late yes leaves trip and country intact, without reviving rejected proposal.

findings.fact: Old80 F015/F047 include Санкт-Петербрг and Мосвкы. Literal grounding rejected even a correctly proposed canonical city without a useful targeted suggestion.
findings.fix: One edit or adjacent transposition against curated aliases after explicit origin/destination cues can propose one unique city for confirmation, never commit it. Residence, transit, country names, questions, quoted and non-current material are excluded.
findings.controlled_proof: Three initial FAILs, pure negatives, and two six-turn PG typo/yes/FAQ/pause/budget dialogues.
findings.actual_closure: Repeat both source-inspired compound typos through real LLM; other facts persist, confirmation owns the correct role and later budget changes do not undo it.

findings.fact: The approved Serbia-only bare Белгород correction did not recognise ordinary trailing period/exclamation punctuation.
findings.fix: Normalise bare-answer punctuation while keeping question marks non-consensual and never changing the global Belgorod/Russia registry.
findings.controlled_proof: Visible Понял как «Белград», Сербия. in pure and twelve-turn PG assertions; explicit Russia and global aliases retain old guards.
findings.actual_closure: Actual Serbian-context bare typo reply visibly acknowledges Belgrade; explicit Russia and real country disagreement remain distinct.

root_integration_dependency.facts: Root added canonical known-city/country and alias FAQ handling after two initial QA failures plus the alias no-edit failure.
root_integration_dependency.ownership: Root answering.py/harness.py, not modified by this geo actor.
